definition: Estimates Geothermal Planet-Scale readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a geo hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Geothermal Planet-Scale Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Geothermal Planet-Scale operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Geothermal Planet-Scale installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 24469 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where deep wells monitoring, geo logistics redundancy, or drilling tech maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Geothermal Planet-Scale Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Geothermal Planet-Scale: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Geothermal Planet-Scale — tapping Earth's heat at continental scale.

Phase 1 — Prove (deep wells): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (geo logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (drilling tech): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (reservoir engineering): geo hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and continents-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
